title: Mavci verification verdict
description: Write-once, never deleted. The audit trail. Every string passes through redact.mjs before it is written.

verdict.description: `incomplete` is not a soft fail. It is the state where the verdict does not answer the question it was asked - a criterion nobody ran, or no `criteria` at all. Finding 6: two values could not say that, so it was said as `pass`.

criteria.description: One entry per numbered acceptance criterion in the approved spec. OPTIONAL in this schema and REQUIRED by the router, which is tighter rather than looser: `required` under additionalProperties:false would invalidate every verdict written before 0.1.33 - the propagation window, in the direction that breaks the live tree - while binding only documents that already carry the field. The router treats absence as `incomplete`, so an old verdict decides nothing rather than deciding wrongly. Same reasoning as `source` on the guardian record (0.1.21).

not_checked.description: Rules that ran correctly over an EMPTY INPUT SET. Deliberately a separate tally from `pass`: a probe with nothing to probe is not a passing probe (finding 5). Required, so a build that computes the other five and silently drops this one fails here rather than reporting a smaller universe.

id.description: The criterion's number or identifier as it appears in the approved spec. A string, not an integer, so a spec numbering its criteria 4a and 4b does not have to renumber to be recordable.

status.description: `skipped` is a decision recorded before the run; `not_run` is an absence nobody decided. One `not_run` makes the verdict `incomplete`.

mode.description: How the result was obtained. `inspected` means read, not run - legitimate, and not execution. Required, so a build that records results without saying which fails here rather than reporting inspection as execution.
